description:
The account's credit balance, what it has spent per model, and which queue your next job enters.

`community`: Whether your next job runs free on the community queue: same models, smaller size limits on most of those that return a picture, longer waits at busy times. True without credit or a subscription, or once a limited subscription's monthly allowance is spent. Otherwise it runs on paid compute.

`credits_remaining`: Credits left to spend, never below zero. Zero does not stop a submission, and no top-up is needed: `community` says which queue it enters. Nothing is owed for what the balance does not cover: it is written off when credit next arrives or a subscription renews.

`subscription_allowance`: Credits of work a month a limited subscription puts on paid compute. Null for an unlimited subscription or none. It adds nothing to `credits_remaining`.

The user buys credit or a subscription at https://craterview.ai/dashboard#buy; no tool buys anything.
name: get_usage
